name: drizzle-orm
readme_excerpt: Headless ORM for NodeJS, TypeScript and JavaScript 🚀 Website • Documentation • Twitter • Discord What's Drizzle? Drizzle is a modern TypeScript ORM developers wanna use in their next project. It is lightweight at only ~7.4kb minified+gzipped, and it's tree shakeable with exactly 0 dependencies. Drizzle supports every PostgreSQL, MySQL and SQLite database, including serverless ones like Turso, Neon, Xata, PlanetScale, Cloudflare D1, FlyIO LiteFS, Vercel Postgres, Supabase and AWS Data API.
